Credit attribution reflects professional standards in media production.
The speaker has authority over who is credited on the show.
Listed individuals have made meaningful contributions to the show.
Audience members value knowing behind-the-scenes roles.
Executive producers play a key role in shaping the show’s direction.
Music composition is a distinct and important contribution to audio shows.
Editing and recording are critical technical components of podcast production.
The speaker identifies with the show and its team as part of their professional identity.
